title: 2048 Classic
description: Join numerical tiles and work your way up to the legendary 2048 tile in this relaxing mathematical slider.
controls: Arrow Keys or W/A/S/D to slide tiles, Swipe on mobile
author: Gabriele Cirulli & Nova Arcade

title: Tetris Arcade
description: The quintessential Russian falling-block puzzle. Line up tetrominoes, trigger combos, and climb endless levels.
controls: Left/Right to move, Up to rotate, Down for soft drop, Space for hard drop
author: Alexey Pajitnov Retro Port

title: Space Asteroids
description: Navigate a vector spacecraft through hazardous meteor belts, shattering rocks and evading cosmic collisions.
controls: Left/Right to rotate, Up for thrusters, Space to blast laser, Shift for hyperspace
author: Atari Classic Labs

title: Snake 97 Retro
description: Relive the legendary green-screen Nokia snake arcade game. Eat apples, grow longer, and avoid your own tail.
controls: Arrow keys or W-A-S-D to steer snake
author: Taneli Armanto Retro

title: Flappy Bird Neon
description: Tap your wings to flap through endless emerald pipe gates. One mistimed tap and it's game over!
controls: Spacebar or Left Click to flap
author: Dong Nguyen Style

title: Pong 1972
description: The original video game showdown. Deflect high-speed sonic volleys against an adaptive CPU paddle.
controls: Mouse cursor, W/S or Up/Down arrows to control paddle
author: Allan Alcorn Arcade

title: Breakout Brick Buster
description: Shatter rainbow rows of colored bricks with a high-velocity steel sphere and responsive paddle bar.
controls: Mouse or Left/Right arrow keys to move paddle
author: Wozniak Breakout Tribute

title: T-Rex Dino Runner
description: The internet is offline! Leap over desert cacti, duck under flying pterodactyls, and beat your personal record.
controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to duck
author: Chromium Desert Team

title: Cookie Clicker Mini
description: Bake millions of sweet chocolate chip cookies. Hire bakers, build farms and cookie mines, and dominate the confectionery empire.
controls: Click giant cookie, click shop items to purchase upgrades
author: Orteil Tribute Edition

title: Wordle Unlimited
description: Guess the hidden 5-letter word in six attempts. Green means correct spot, yellow means right letter wrong spot.
controls: Type letters on keyboard or click on-screen virtual keyboard
author: Josh Wardle Tribute
